blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Indigent senior citizens may use any valid government-issued ID card when claiming their Social Pension for Indigent Senior Citizens (SPISC), the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) clarified on Friday. While using the National ID remains encouraged, it is not a mandatory requirement for the payout. DSWD spokesperson Asst. Secretary […]...
